visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, messy hair and a grey oversized t-shirt walks toward the camera in a brightly lit indoor office setting. He is holding papers and a black folder, looking focused until he suddenly collides with an unseen object. (2) A second persona appears with a vibrant pink and purple wig and a brown jacket, engaging in dramatic, jerky dance movements and exaggerated facial expressions with wide eyes and an open mouth. The background remains a cluttered office with desks and boxes. (3) A third persona is introduced wearing a long blonde wig, looking distressed and holding their face. They are standing in front of a dark brown door, gesturing wildly with their hands as if arguing or complaining. (4) The pink-haired persona holds a package of Sofy sanitary pants while performing stylized dance steps. The camera cuts to close-ups of a transparent mannequin torso wearing the product. Hands are shown demonstrating the Velcro waist straps, tearing the side of the material, and pulling it to show elasticity. (5) Close-up shots highlight the product's internal features, including red and orange graphic overlays pointing to the leak guards and absorption core. The man in the grey t-shirt returns, dancing vigorously and doing high kicks, while yellow and orange text overlays flash across the screen. (6) In the final scene, the man in the grey shirt holds the product up to his face, stretching it wide. He later appears holding a white cake-like object, looking surprised and shouting. The pink-haired persona finishes by holding the product package near their face against a plain background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an advertisement for Sofy sanitary pants, utilizing a comedic, high-energy skit format typical of short-form social media content. It aims to demonstrate the convenience of the product's Velcro waist strap (allowing changes without removing outer clothes) and its leak protection through a mix of character-driven humor and clear product demonstrations.
